name: V-set and transmembrane domain containing 2A

function.text: VSTM2A encodes v-set and transmembrane domain-containing protein 2A. It participates in positive regulation of gene expression and positive regulation of lipid storage.

function.text: VSTM2A encodes v-set and transmembrane domain-containing protein 2A. It contributes to the regulation of the early stage of white and brown preadipocyte cell differentiation. It promotes adipogenic commitment of preadipocytes by increasing gene expression of the transcription factor PPARG in a BMP4-dependent signaling pathway.
